description: Main source file for EcuM module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive system, managing power states, wakeup validation, sleep modes, and transitions between different operational states.

methods.name: set_current_state
methods.description: Updates the current power state of the EcuM module and adjusts the RTE mode accordingly based on the new state.

methods.name: EcuM_enter_run_mode
methods.description: Transitions the system into the RUN mode, initializes watchdog and communication modules, and indicates run mode to other components.

methods.name: enter_go_sleep_mode
methods.description: Prepares the system to enter sleep mode, enabling wakeup sources and transitioning to ECUM_STATE_GO_SLEEP.

methods.name: in_state_goSleep
methods.description: Handles activities in sleep state, including enabling wakeup sources and checking for pending wakeup events.

methods.name: in_state_sleep
methods.description: Performs activities during sleep, such as generating RAM hash, setting MCU sleep mode, and transitioning to wakeup.

methods.name: enter_go_off_one_mode
methods.description: Transitions system into go-off-one mode, deinitializes communication, and initiates NVM write and shutdown.

methods.name: hasRunRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are any active run requests.

methods.name: hasPostRunRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are any post-run requests pending.

methods.name: in_state_appRun
methods.description: Handles activities in RUN II state, including timeout management and transition to post-run.

methods.name: in_state_appPostRun
methods.description: Handles activities in RUN III state, managing return to run or transition to shutdown.

methods.name: in_state_prepShutdown
methods.description: Prepares system for shutdown, including calling shutdown hooks and transitioning to off or sleep.

methods.name: in_state_goOffOne
methods.description: Handles activities in go-off-one state, waiting for NVM operations to complete before shutdown.

methods.name: EcuM_MainFunction
methods.description: Main loop managing state transitions and activities based on current power state.
